brief: #110's working roof — 24 pieces, the largest built thing in the near frame — is invisible at framings we ship. #117 measured 20 of the 24 covered by the sill at 1280x700; c179 says all 24 at 1280x700 and 1200x720, visible only at 1600x950 and on a phone. Count them yourself on HEAD at all five tracked sizes first; the two readings disagree and the difference matters. The cause is already a law: ROOF_FURN sits on rows 86..87 because they are the only level rows below the ridge, and sillTop() lands at world depth 81.7 at 1280x700 against 120 on a phone — a world-space ROW bound on the near block is safe at no size. Bound the furniture in DEPTH for the SHORTEST framing you support (ROOF_DMAX 82.2 is the number the roof birds already use) and place it accordingly, keeping FURN_BOX, roofFurnAt and roofFurnName reading the same pieces they read now.
successLooksLike: At every tracked framing a clear majority of ROOF_FURN is on screen — measured, not eyeballed — with nothing lost at 1600x950 or on a phone, and every piece still answers the pointer with the words it answers with today.
avoid: Do not shrink the sill or change sillTop(): eight systems price off that line, including the foreground ramp. Do not delete pieces to raise the ratio.
